title: Integrative bioinformatics and deep learning to identify common genetic pathways in Crohn's disease and ischemic cardiomyopathy.
authors: Maddah, Reza; Aghili, Zahra Sadat; Ghanbari, Fahimeh; Najafabadi, Amirhossein Hajialiasgary; Asgary, Sedigheh
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过整合生物信息学和深度学习识别克罗恩病与缺血性心肌病的共同遗传通路，虽涉及转录因子调控网络分析，但核心是疾病基因表达与诊断分类，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Crohn's disease (CD) and ischemic cardiomyopathy (ICM) share inflammatory characteristics, yet their common genetic underpinnings remain underexplored. Using an integrative bioinformatics approach, we analyzed GEO datasets (GSE3365 and GSE9128) to identify shared genetic pathways between CD and ICM. Through differential expression analysis, we identified 60 common differentially expressed genes (CDEGs). Functional enrichment analysis revealed enrichment in inflammatory pathways, including NF-kappaB and TNF-alpha signaling, highlighting their role in disease pathogenesis. We conducted microRNA (miRNA), transcription factor (TF), and protein-protein interaction (PPI) analyses to uncover regulatory networks. Notably, hsa-miR-98-5p emerged as a key miRNA, while RELA and NFKB1 were identified as prominent TFs interacting with CDEGs. Six hub genes-IL1B, CXCL8, CXCL2, TLR2, FCGR1A, and FCGR2A-were pinpointed, demonstrating high diagnostic potential via receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis. To advance diagnostic precision, we developed AutoClass, a deep learning framework that leverages hub gene regulatory networks to classify CD patients with approximately 95 % accuracy. These hub genes and regulators likely drive neutrophil-mediated inflammation, offering insights into the molecular interplay between CD and ICM. Our findings suggest that the identified CDEGs, miRNAs, and TFs hold promise as therapeutic targets and biomarkers, paving the way for precision medicine approaches in managing CD and its cardiovascular complications. Future experimental validation and cohort expansion could further elucidate these shared mechanisms, enhancing their translational impact.
abstract_zh: 克罗恩病（Crohn's disease, CD）与缺血性心肌病（ischemic cardiomyopathy, ICM）具有共同的炎症特征，然而它们之间的共同遗传基础仍未得到充分探索。通过整合生物信息学方法，我们分析了GEO数据集（GSE3365和GSE9128），以识别CD与ICM之间的共享遗传通路。通过差异表达分析，我们鉴定了60个共同的差异表达基因（CDEGs）。功能富集分析揭示了炎症通路的富集，包括NF-kappaB和TNF-alpha信号传导，突出了它们在疾病发病机制中的作用。我们进行了microRNA（miRNA）、转录因子（transcription factor, TF）和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interaction, PPI）分析，以揭示调控网络。值得注意的是，hsa-miR-98-5p被确定为一个关键miRNA，而RELA和NFKB1被识别为与CDEGs相互作用的主要转录因子。六个枢纽基因——IL1B、CXCL8、CXCL2、TLR2、FCGR1A和FCGR2A——被精确定位，并通过受试者工作特征（receiver operating characteristic, ROC）分析显示出高诊断潜力。为了提升诊断精度，我们开发了AutoClass，一种深度学习框架，利用枢纽基因调控网络以约95%的准确率对CD患者进行分类。这些枢纽基因和调控因子可能驱动中性粒细胞介导的炎症，为CD与ICM之间的分子相互作用提供了见解。我们的发现表明，所识别的CDEGs、miRNAs和转录因子有望成为治疗靶点和生物标志物，为精准医学方法在管理CD及其心血管并发症中的应用铺平道路。未来的实验验证和队列扩展可能进一步阐明这些共享机制，增强其转化影响。
